schools.name: Sennen Surfing Centre
schools.note: One of the UK's longest-running surf schools, with one- to five-day courses for beginners, improvers and intermediates, plus private one-to-one, two-to-one and small-group lessons. All equipment is included and the first session covers beach safety.

schools.name: Smart Surf School
schools.note: Small group lessons with a maximum of six students, private tuition and kids' surf clubs. It was formerly known as Sennen Surf School.

hire.name: Sennen Surfing Centre
hire.base: Sennen Cove village, by the beach
hire.note: Board and wetsuit hire alongside lessons in the village; check with the beach cabin for what's available on the day.

shops.name: Sennen Surf Co
shops.note: A family-run surf and beach shop open daily, with surfboards and longboards, clothing and accessories.

shops.name: Sennen Surfing Centre shop
shops.note: Sells entry and advanced O'Neill wetsuits and surf hardware, in store or online for collection when you arrive.

lessonsIntro: Sennen is England's most westerly surf beach, and two surf schools teach right on the sand. It picks up swell when much of Cornwall is flat.

text: Sennen sits at the southern end of Whitesand Bay, about a mile from Land's End, and is fully open to Atlantic swell. That means there's usually a wave, but it also means some days bring big surf that isn't for beginners. The southern end is a bit more sheltered than Gwenver at the far end of the bay. It works on most tides except the very top, and a rising tide often brings the best waves.

Sennen Surfing Centre has a cabin on the beach, and its first session for beginners covers beach safety and the kit. Smart Surf School also teaches in the cove with small groups. RNLI lifeguards patrol daily from early April to the start of November, and they move the flags with the tide, so check where the black and white surf zone is each time you go in.

cards.label: Level
cards.title: All levels, with a school on big days
cards.text: Both schools take complete beginners, but the beach can get large rollers, so learn with a lesson rather than alone.

cards.label: Best time
cards.title: Lifeguarded season, smaller swells
cards.text: Lifeguards are on duty daily from 3 April to 1 November in 2026. Pick smaller days and avoid the very top of the tide.

cards.label: Watch out for
cards.title: Full Atlantic exposure
cards.text: Sennen is exposed to Atlantic swells. If nobody is in the water, there may be a good reason, so ask the lifeguards first.

hireIntro: Surf kit can be hired in the cove itself, next to the beach. Lessons at both schools include boards and wetsuits.

text: A big foam board is the right choice for learning in Sennen's often powerful whitewater, and both schools supply boards with lessons. Improvers can step down once they're comfortable in green waves. Sea temperatures here range from about 8 to 10°C in late February to 15 to 19°C in mid-August.

cards.label: Board
cards.title: Foam board to start
cards.text: Lessons include boards. Stick to high-volume soft boards until you're riding green waves comfortably.

cards.label: Wetsuit
cards.title: 4/3 or 3/2 in summer, 5mm in winter
cards.text: Surf-forecast suggests a 4/3mm (or 3/2 with boots) in August, and a 5/4 or 5/3mm with gloves and boots in late February.

cards.label: Other craft
cards.title: Bodyboards between the flags
cards.text: Bodyboarders swim between the red and yellow flags. Surfboards stay in the black and white zone, which moves with the tide.

shopsIntro: Sennen Cove has a family-run surf shop by the beach car park, and the surfing centre sells wetsuits and hardware.
shopsText: Everything is within a short walk in the cove. Sennen Surf Co sits at the beach car park and stocks boards, longboards, clothing and accessories, opening daily. Sennen Surfing Centre sells O'Neill wetsuits and surf hardware, which you can order online and pick up when you arrive.

lessons.q: Which surf schools teach at Sennen?
lessons.a: Sennen Surfing Centre, on the beach, and Smart Surf School (formerly Sennen Surf School), also based in the cove.
Yes with a school, as both teach first-timers. On big Atlantic swells it's better suited to experienced surfers.
Sennen Surfing Centre includes all equipment, and the first beginner session starts with beach safety.

hire.q: Can I hire a board at Sennen?
hire.a: Yes, board and wetsuit hire is available in the cove through Sennen Surfing Centre.

hire.q: Can I hire if I've never surfed?
hire.a: You can, but Sennen can get powerful, so a lesson is the safer first step.

shops.q: Is there a surf shop in Sennen Cove?
shops.a: Yes, Sennen Surf Co by the beach car park, open daily, and Sennen Surfing Centre sells wetsuits and hardware.
